annotations.text: Hydronic pressure-drop editor — readability redesign (existing strings preserved; approved additive section-PD surfaces shown separately)

Defects tagged on the Current artboard, with evidence:

1. style.css:37 sizes the caption "System headline:" at 1.35rem while the governing value stays 1.02rem — the number the tool exists to produce is smaller than its own label.

2. main.tsx:87 — the red status names four possible causes ("engine diagnostics, topology, applicability, or margin") and links to none; the actual blocker list renders only on the Results tab (main.tsx:94).

3. main.tsx:90 + style.css:56,59 — node inputs are labeled by raw node id (uppercased to T1 / SPLIT / MERGE), sharing one 4-column grid with pump selects and the Add node button; ids read as field types and there is no group boundary.

4. main.tsx:91 — the margin acknowledgment checkbox is a headline-blocking gate but renders at the same weight as the four category checkboxes, which wrap to odd grid positions.

5. style.css:63,69 — equal-width grid columns give 2-digit numeric fields ~330px, the same width as text fields; width no longer signals expected content.

Also found (not tagged): main.tsx:94 renders each circuit's diagnostics red in-card AND repeats all of them in the system list — 7 red lines for 2 distinct actions. main.tsx:93 — the Inspect radio lives on Circuits but only affects Results. main.tsx:85 — summaryStatus is built with a stray leading space (' ' + …).

Proposed System tab.

Summary bar is value-first: the governing number is the largest text on screen, its caption sits above it in label style. When blocked, the value shows the exact "unavailable ft / unavailable psi." string, muted, and a "View 7 blockers in Results" affordance routes to the diagnostics (ADDITIVE control — new string, needs contract sign-off; switching tabs is UI state only).

System card splits into three bounded groups: System (project, system, fluid, temp — temp narrowed to 150px), Pump connection, and Nodes. Node rows are name-first; the raw id becomes a chip caption instead of a shouting field label. Delete sits with its row.

Margin: percent field narrowed, categories on one line, and the acknowledgment promoted to an amber gate row reusing the app's notice tokens (#fff6d9 / #bc8200). The checkbox label string is unchanged; the small text beside it is the engine's own margin diagnostic string.

Proposed Sections tab.

Section card gets a header row: name + role/flow chip ("supply; 30 GPM derived" — same words, now a chip) + live Section PD + Duplicate/Delete pinned top-right, so the value is visible where the section is edited and actions stop floating mid-card. Rows are grouped by meaning: identity, topology (From → To with an arrow, length narrowed with the label's own text), geometry. The derived-geometry line becomes a quiet inset strip.

Loss card: id + applicability state chip in the header, Confirm current basis promoted to a filled primary button (it is the gate). The basis sentence — the text the engineer must actually read before confirming — moves to its own inset block at 14.5px instead of a run-on footnote.

Proposed Circuits tab.

The circuit reads left-to-right as the loop actually flows: Supply path lane → Terminal lane → Return path lane. Path entries become ordered rows with compact Remove/Up/Down. GPM input narrowed to 170px. The second circuit is shown collapsed to one row (ADDITIVE progressive disclosure — needs contract sign-off; the helper sentence in the terminal lane and the collapsed-row caption are new strings).

Proposed Results tab.

One "Blocking diagnostics" panel with a count chip replaces the scatter of full-red boxes; every existing diagnostic line is kept verbatim (duplicates included — deduping would change what tests can assert), but rendered as a calm list. Per-circuit copies stay inside their circuit at footnote weight. Trace lines keep their exact strings, gain tabular numerals and a hanging-indent rail. The Inspect switch is duplicated into the circuit header (ADDITIVE — same radio state as the Circuits tab control).

Summary bar states.

All five acceptance/status states with exact app strings, including the two stale variants and the invalid-raw state. Proposed: the accent top border changes with state (teal working, green accepted, amber stale, red invalid) and acceptance states render as chips. "Blocked" mutes the unavailable value; "ready" is the only state where the number is full-strength ink.

Explicitly unchanged everywhere: every existing user-visible string, aria-label, diagnostic, gating rule, and the engine/persistence layers. New strings appear only in the ADDITIVE controls called out above and the approved per-section PD surfaces.

Approved direction: show section PD in both places.

On Sections, every card header gets a Section PD readout. An available row shows ft and loss-equivalent psi; a gated row shows unavailable using the same fail-closed behavior as the engine. This keeps edit-and-see together.

On Results, Section totals is the map of every physical section: name, role, derived shared flow, total head, loss-equivalent psi, and availability. The values shown are from the current synthetic project (Branch 1: 0.3742 ft / 0.1621 psi; Branch 2: 1.9150 ft / 0.8294 psi); gated sections remain unavailable rather than fabricating numbers.

Crucial rule: there is deliberately no grand-total row. Physical-section values cannot all be summed into the system headline because parallel branches are alternatives. The governing headline remains the highest complete circuit path, with shared sections counted once on that path.

These two surfaces and their labels are additive UI approved by Victor after reviewing the first canvas.
